summary_md:
# X-faktorn kan få fart på aktien

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-07-31  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Dagens Industri Kort & Lång hosts cover a new all-time high on the Stockholm exchange and a volatile run of US tech Q2 reports. Microsoft jumped after reassuring investors on AI capex while Meta fell after raising its capex guidance. They warn that global and emerging-market index funds are heavily concentrated in AI names such as TSMC, SK Hynix and Samsung. On single stocks, they suggest AstraZeneca could buy Sobi, argue Storytel looks undervalued at about 17x earnings despite the Spotify threat, call Hexagon an interesting and relatively cheap case with a humanoid-robot option, and take a wait-and-see view on Verisure after its weak post-IPO run.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 STORY-B — Storytel | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong Q2: margin 19.2%, guidance raised to 900m, net cash, about 17x earnings; Spotify worries seen as overdone.

#### Reasoning

Host (Agneta Jönsson) argues Storytel has turned into a profitable, debt-free organic grower that is ahead of its 20% margin target for 2028 and has raised FY guidance. ARPU is rising in the Nordics. Spotify's 12-hour cap limits competition for heavy listeners, and the partnership adds revenue. At about 17x earnings the valuation is low versus history, and Spotify could buy the company. She says there is more to gain.

#### Sell Triggers

- If Spotify's audiobook push erodes Nordic subscriber growth or ARPU
- If the margin trend toward 20% reverses
- If FY operating profit guidance is cut

> *"Jag tycker det har kommit lite i skymundan faktiskt. Så där finns lite mer att hämta."*

---

### 🟠 HEXA-B — Hexagon | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

12% organic growth vs 6% expected; decentralisation story; relatively cheap; humanoid robotics is an X-factor option.

#### Reasoning

Host Mikael Olsson calls Hexagon definitely interesting and cheaper than Swedish engineering peers. Q2 organic growth doubled expectations, driven by defence, semiconductors and reshoring in North America. Rosengren's decentralisation model will take time. The humanoid robot is currently priced as a pure cost, and a clearer commitment to it could lift the option value. Comparisons get harder in H2 2026. He says to keep an eye on the robotics part.

#### Sell Triggers

- If the robot spending is not followed by commercial traction
- If the AI hype fades and the robotics costs weigh on the stock
- If organic growth slows sharply on tougher comparisons in H2 2026
- If governance or cash-flow problems return

> *"Så Hexagon, definitivt ett intressant bolag. Håll koll på robotikdelen."*

---

### 🟡 VSURE — Verisure | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Delivers exactly on guidance and all 12 analysts rate it a buy with about 50% upside, but the stock keeps falling after the IPO; host says wait and see.

#### Reasoning

Host Agneta Jönsson notes solid execution: recurring revenue +12%, margin 26.3% toward a 30% target, leverage down to 2.7x and a first dividend. Consensus target is near EUR 17. Yet the stock is down about a third from its IPO-day peak and fell 4% on the report. DI recommended subscribing at the IPO. Her current stance is 'vänta och se', and the IPO lesson is to think twice when there is hype before a listing.

#### Sell Triggers

- If it misses its recurring-revenue growth or margin targets
- If deleveraging stalls above the 2.5-2.8x target range

> *"det är vänta och se-läge, tycker jag"*

---

### 🟠 SOBI — Sobi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host pitches Sobi as a logical acquisition target for AstraZeneca after its study setbacks.

#### Reasoning

Host Mikael Olsson argues that AstraZeneca's study setbacks raise its incentive to acquire to reach its 2030 target. It already owns about 10% of Sobi, blocked the Advent/GIC bid, and shares Investor as a major owner, so a deal would be 'klockren'. This is speculative, and AstraZeneca says its M&A strategy is unchanged.

#### Sell Triggers

- If AstraZeneca rules out a Sobi deal
- If AstraZeneca sells its stake

> *"Jag tror det vore en klockren affär nu."*

---

### 🟢 SPOT — Spotify | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Reports Tuesday; DI colleague Magnus Dagel recently recommended a buy.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited colleague recommendation, not the hosts' own view. The hosts only mention that Magnus Dagel at DI recently recommended buying Spotify ahead of the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- If Tuesday's report disappoints

> *"där har vår kollega Magnus Dagel ganska nyligen rekommenderat ett köp på dem"*

---
